args.body: Reuse any finished control under STREAM-CATALOGUE-ACCEPTANCE-CONTROL. Otherwise read director-stream-barcode-control.json if committed and compare its draft hash with decision-binding.json. If no saved output fixture passed, recover the exact generation command and positional arguments used in TASK-179567316115 rather than searching the same fixture directory again. Use a verified baseline and one-field negative control to clear or narrow the grouped identifier claim before CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT forwards the existing draft for an operator decision. If the output or command cannot be recovered, record that gap and the evidence that would reopen the test. Close under a valid lease after committed readback with a lesson. Keep the draft unsent and the price provisional.
